probes.description: the target container's Pod spec names both resources.limits.memory and resources.limits.cpu
cgroup-v2 memory.max on the real container cgroup equals resources.limits.memory, converted to bytes
cgroup-v2 cpu.max quota on the real container cgroup equals resources.limits.cpu converted against a 100000us period
nr_throttled in the pod-level cgroup's cpu.stat advances after a 4-way CPU-burn burst inside an isolated, throwaway 100m-quota pod this script owns
probes.expectation: nr_throttled after > nr_throttled before — proves the quota is enforced by the kernel, not merely written to a file

probes.description: the host root cgroup's own cpu.stat is readable and distinct from the container leaf checked above (sanity: this probe is reading the container, not the root, by construction)
probes.expectation: root nr_periods readable (informational control, not a pass/fail on the container's behaviour)
